Meet your mentor

Hi, I'm Jac.

A mom of 2, wife, former middle school math teacher with a mechanical engineering degree, and a woman who has been starting businesses since I was 16 because one career was never going to fucking cut it for me.

I have always known how to work and make money. I can sell. I can build shit. I can have an idea and have the entire thing up and running before most people finish their breakfast.

And for a long time, I thought that was enough. I was working like crazy, saying yes to business I had absolutely no business saying yes to, taking clients I couldn’t stand because money was money, and constantly making decisions from this underlying feeling of: I need this. I need more. I need to make sure more is coming.

I always knew I’d be successful. I always have been.

You can make a lot of fucking money while operating from lack.

You can also build a life that looks successful as hell and realize you’ve been making half your decisions based on what you’re scared will happen if you don’t.

At one point, I did a moon ritual and saw an entirely different version of my life. Not just more money. Not just a bigger business. My life. The way I worked. The way I felt. The way I made decisions. The kind of mother and wife I got to be. The freedom I had. The woman I was inside all of it.

I literally saw myself creating a space like the one you’re sitting here reading about right now.

And from there, I made a bunch of switcheroos.

I shut down my coaching business, essentially took a year off from coaching, started a completely different business, and made six figures my first year, including $30K in the first four months.

And then shit started getting really fun.

I went from saying yes to clients I couldn’t stand because I was afraid of where the next dollar was coming from to having clients pay me multiple five figures. I’ve worked with Fortune 500 companies. NBA teams. Companies I once would’ve thought were completely out of reach were suddenly sitting in my inbox asking ME to work with them.

Mentors I hired wanted to hire ME.

But the money is only part of why I look at my life now and think, holy fuck.

I built businesses I actually love. I make more money than I ever have. I can go to the gym at noon and get a facial at 9 AM on a Tuesday. I don’t miss my kids’ school events or gymnastics. I can randomly take them to Disney in the middle of the week. I can work way too late because I’m obsessed with an idea, take half the next day off because I feel like it, or have some midday hankypanky with my husband because apparently that’s also what entrepreneurship was invented for. 😂

I designed my life this way.

Not because I stopped working. I fucking love working. And not because I found some magical strategy that made everything easy.

  • I stopped treating somebody else’s version of success like it had to be mine.
  • I stopped making decisions based on fear and calling it logic.
  • And I stopped thinking I could journal about the reality I wanted for twenty minutes and then spend the other 23 hours and 40 minutes being someone completely different.

I was already doing the affirmations. I had them saved all over my phone. I visualized. I journaled. I believed in manifestation.

Then I’d close the app and spend the rest of the day making decisions from lack.

Affirmations don’t mean shit if the way you’re actually living, choosing, and moving says the exact opposite.

Because you’re manifesting all day long.

When you decide what to charge. Who you’ll work with. What you expect when you launch. What you make a slow week mean. How you react when money goes out. Whether you trust the idea or immediately run to Instagram to see how somebody else did it first.

But also when you decide what kind of marriage you get to have. How you take care of your body. What you tolerate. What you say no to. Whether you make time for the things you claim matter to you. Whether you let yourself want something simply because you fucking want it.

I changed what I believed about money. I changed what I believed was available to me. I learned how to calm the fuck down when the 3D showed me something I didn’t like without deciding it was suddenly a prophecy for my future.

And I started trusting myself enough to actually ACT on the things I said I wanted.

Today, I run two multi-six-figure businesses and $40K+ months are normal in my world.

But I also genuinely fucking love my life.

And that matters to me just as much.

Because I’m not interested in helping you build an impressive business while the woman running it gets whatever scraps are left over.

I want the money AND the life.

That’s why the work we do here isn’t just business strategy. And it isn’t manifestation while we pretend the physical world doesn’t exist.

We look at all of it.

What do you actually want?
What have you made normal?
What do you believe is available to you?
What happens when reality gives you something you don’t fucking like?
What needs to change in the business?
What needs to change in YOU?
And what are you actually going to DO about it?

Because when those pieces start moving together, this gets so much bigger than building a better business.

You make more money doing shit you actually love. You feel incredible in your body. Your relationships get better. You stop giving so much of a fuck what everybody thinks. You trust yourself. You take care of yourself. You make the move. You say the thing. You become unavailable for the shit you’ve outgrown. And the life you used to think about having someday starts becoming the one you’re actually fucking living.

What it’s actually like

What is it actually like to be coached by me?

I am not the coach who is going to tell you to just remember who you are every time something goes wrong and call that identity work.

Sometimes you’re going to be scared. Sometimes you’re going to be pissed off. Something you were convinced was happening might not happen. Money might get weird. Your marriage might hit a nerve. You might hate how you feel in your body that week. You might make a decision you regret. You might come into the room completely overwhelmed and tell me everything fucking sucks.

I will hold space for that.

Because you are a human being creating an incredible life, not a robot who needs to maintain the correct frequency 24/7 or she gets kicked out of the manifestation club.

But you’re also not going to live there.

We’re going to figure out what’s actually happening.

Is your nervous system completely lit up right now? Is there a subconscious belief underneath this? Are you making this mean something about yourself or your future that it doesn’t actually mean? Is old shit coming up? Is the 3D just not matching what you decided yet? Or is there something in your business, relationships, habits, decisions, or life that genuinely needs to fucking change?

That’s coaching to me.

I am a slut for subconscious work.

I want to know what’s underneath the reaction, not just hype you up enough that you can temporarily bulldoze over it.

And when you’re ready, we move.

Make the decision.Change the strategy.Have the conversation.Launch the thing.Raise the price.Set the boundary.Go to the gym.Book the trip.Leave the thing you know you’ve outgrown.Say what you actually fucking mean.Take the aligned action.

Whatever the actual situation calls for.

I’m not here to make you dependent on me to tell you what to do every time life throws something at you.

I’m here to help you know yourself, trust yourself, and become so fucking unshakable in what you want that when life inevitably lifes, you know how to move through it without abandoning the reality you decided you’re creating.

FAQ

Is HFTIML for me if I’m nervous about joining?+

You can absolutely be nervous about making a $5,000 investment.

What I’m not going to do is convince you to make it.

You do not need to perform certainty for me. You don’t need to pretend $5,000 is nothing. And you don’t need to be fearless to belong in this room.

But you do need to be able to make your own decision.

I want women in this room who are serious about the life they say they want. Women who are willing to be coached, look at their shit, try things, make decisions, get information, adjust, and keep moving.

Not perfectly. Not without fear. Not without having very human moments.

But then you fucking move.

If you need me to repeatedly convince you that you should be here, this probably isn’t the room for you.

Do you guarantee I’ll make my investment back?+

No.

There are no guarantees around how much money you’ll make, how quickly you’ll make it, or what specifically will happen in your business or life during these six months.

I cannot promise you that because I am not the one making your decisions or taking the action. You are.

You’ll have the room, the coaching, the strategy, the manifestation and subconscious work, the tools, and the support.

What you do with them is yours.

If you need a guaranteed financial outcome before you’re willing to make the investment, don’t join.

Do you offer refunds or a trial period?+

No.

HFTIML is a six-month mentorship. There is no 30-day “let me see if I like it” trial period.

When you join, you’re committing to the six months.

This isn’t something you dabble in for three weeks and then decide whether creating the life you actually fucking want is “working” fast enough.

What if I’m already in another program?+

Being in another program does not automatically mean HFTIML isn’t for you.

But I’m also not interested in telling you to abandon a commitment you’ve already made because this shiny new thing appeared in front of you.

Look at what you’re already committed to. Look at what you actually want. Look at why you want to be in this room too.

Then make the decision like the woman you say you’re becoming.
